items.d: The building block of all organic life. Of critical importance to space travellers, as Carbon is used to recharge mining equipment. The Mining Laser will harvest Carbon from trees, plants, and all other forms of vegetable.

Advanced material, processed from regular carbon in a Refiner. The increased molecule density offers a substantially improved energy-per-gram ratio. Occasionally found in crystalline form. Harvesting large crystals may require a Advanced Mining Laser.

Integral to the atmospheric filtering technology at the heart of the exosuit life support system. Exosuit material processing allows oxygen to be harvested directly from appropriate planetary flora. Other plantlife may be scanned with the Analysis Visor to reveal alternative oxygen supplies.

A stable, crystalline form of hydrogen remarkable both for its extreme energy density and its stability at atmospheric pressures. Common to all worlds, Di-hydrogen is found in the form of large blue crystals. It is a key component of Starship Launch Fuel.

A stable hydrogen isotope used heavily in both small-scale fusion reactors and neutron-scattering shield technology. Deuterium very rarely occurs naturally. Most of the galaxy's supply comes from the processing of Di-hydrogen and Tritium in Refiners.

Radioactive isotope commonly used to fuel the fusion reactor at the heart of starship Pulse Engines. Abundant in interstellar asteroid fields, Tritium can be mined from asteroids using starship weaponry. Scan (SCAN) to search for tritium-rich asteroids.

An abundant mineral element, found in rock formations and other areas of geological interest. Easily extracted using a Mining Laser. Typically requires processing in a Refiner before use in construction or technology manufacture.

Processed metal, free of dust and pebbles. Used to construct a wide variety of structures and technologies. Typically purified from Ferrite dust using a Refiner, but can occasionally be found in large deposits. Collection may require an Advanced Mining Laser.
Highly processed metal, requiring several stages of processing in a Refiner. Used in the creation of advanced structures and technologies. Avoid ingestion.

An abundant mineral element, found within the geological strata of all rocky worlds. Easily extracted using a Terrain Manipulator. Create a tunnel anywhere to begin extraction. Process in a Refiner to create Glass.

A powerful catalyst, useful for charging defensive technologies such as shields or hazard protection. Exosuit material handling technology allows automatic harvesting from appropriate sodium-rich flora. A vital ingredient in the creation of many advanced devices, products and components.

An advanced catalyst, useful for charging defensive technologies such as shields or hazard protection. Created in a Refiner, or occasionally found in crystalline form on a planet's surface. Offers a substantially improved energy-per-gram ratio over regular Sodium.

Mined from underground minerals, cobalt is found in plentiful supply in caves and caverns. Useful in the manufacture of Ion Batteries. It is used in the creation of several technologies and structures, and can be processed in a Refiner to make the most of its inherent charge.

A highly energised form of Cobalt, this processed metal can be used to create Advanced Ion Batteries, a conveniently portable source of energy for the Exosuit. In widespread use as a key component in the creation of advanced technologies and structures.

A naturally occuring salt, found in abundance in underwater minerals. Can be processed in a Refiner to create Chlorine. This refined form is used in the manufacture of advanced products and technologies.
A reactive element most easily harvested by processing the salt-infused minerals found in oceans. Used in the manufacture of advanced technologies.

A blue-green organic compound produced during the metabolic cycle of deep-sea plantlife. Rich in soluble energy, cyto-phosphates are crucial in many submarine technologies. The Mining Laser will harvest cyto-phosphate compounds from underwater flora.

A chromatic metal, generated by fusion in the heart of a star. Such stellar material ends up forming deposits in the crust of local planets. Copper is found on planets orbiting yellow stars, and can be placed in a Refiner to create purified Chromatic Metal for use in the manufacture of advanced technologies.

A chromatic metal, generated by fusion in the heart of a star. Such stellar material ends up forming deposits in the crust of local planets. Cadmium is found on planets orbiting red stars, and can be placed in a Refiner to create purified Chromatic Metal for use in the manufacture of advanced technologies.

A chromatic metal, generated by fusion in the heart of a star. Emeril is found on planets orbiting green stars, and can be placed in a Refiner to create purified Chromatic Metal for use in the manufacture of advanced technologies.

A chromatic metal, generated by fusion in the heart of a star. Such stellar material ends up forming deposits in the crust of local planets. Indium is found on planets orbiting blue stars, and can be placed in a Refiner to create purified Chromatic Metal for use in the manufacture of advanced technologies.

A chromatic mineral, generated by fusion in the heart of a star. Such stellar material ends up forming deposits in the crust of local planets. Quartzite is found on planets orbiting purple stars, and can be placed in a Refiner to create purified Chromatic Metal for use in the manufacture of advanced technologies.

A processed metal alloy, created in a Refiner from the stellar metals: Copper, Cadmium, Emeril and Indium. The rarer the stellar metal, the more Chromatic Metal it will produce. This valuable metal is used in the creation of many advanced technologies.

A dense miasma of Nanites, undulating in its potentiality. These clusters are stable, but unrestricted nanite foam can produce undesirable runaway reactions in the presence of organic matter. Used in the construction of advanced technologies. Highly valuable to specialist traders.
Local mineral extract, typically found in large deposits or extracted from common minerals after inspection with an Analysis Visor. Typically found on planets with a tropical environment.
Local mineral extract, typically found in large deposits or extracted from common minerals after inspection with an Analysis Visor. Typically found on planets with a desert environment.
Local mineral extract, typically found in large deposits or extracted from common minerals after inspection with an Analysis Visor. Typically found on planets with a toxic environment.
Local mineral extract, typically found in large deposits or extracted from common minerals after inspection with an Analysis Visor. Typically found on planets with a radioactive environment.
Local mineral extract, typically found in large deposits or extracted from common minerals after inspection with an Analysis Visor. Typically found on planets with a frozen environment.
Local mineral extract, typically found in large deposits or extracted from common minerals after inspection with an Analysis Visor. Typically found on planets with a scorched environment.
Local mineral extract, typically found in large deposits or extracted from common minerals after inspection with an Analysis Visor. Typically found on planets with a volcanic environment.

The powdery remains of a highly polished mineral surface. It glitters as it catches the light, like fiery grains of sand. Acquired by applying the Mining Laser to the structral remnants located on ruined worlds.
Local metallic extract, typically found in large deposits or harvested from common mineral formations after inspection with an Analysis Visor. Typically found on ocean planets.

A supercooled chemical extract, typically found in large deposits or extracted from smaller mineral formations after inspection with an Analysis Visor. Extracted from deposits formed in the hostile conditions of gas giants.

Despite much study, little is known about this haunting, crystalline compound. It is released from the cadavers of dying creatures, but can also be specifically cultivated and harvested from the Mordite Root plant.

This oily, unsettling liquid leaks from the circuitry of Sentinels. Prized by the Vy'keen, Pugneum is thought to share some essential properties with Nanites. It hums in a sinister fashion upon contact with organic matter.

This ethereal substance spills from the bodies of corrupted Sentinels as they fall, a shower of prismatic grains seeking out their next host. It evades all attempts to contain it, as if it had a will of its own, a strong desire for its own freedom. It possesses a crystalline beauty that cannot be reconciled with the corruption from whence it flows.
Valuable interstellar trading mineral, typically mined from asteroids. Occasionally found in underground planetary deposits. Prized by people in all systems for its lustre and shine.
Highly valuable interstellar trading mineral, typically mined from asteroids. Occasionally found in underground planetary deposits. Universally prized for its beauty and versatility.
Extremely valuable interstellar trading mineral, typically mined from asteroids. Occasionally found in underground planetary deposits. Universally prized for its hardiness and versatility.
A pungent atmospheric gas. High concentrations are extremely hazardous to organic life. With the aid of specialised machinery, can be extracted from the atmospheres of Scorched and Desert planets.
A colourless, odourless gas with a relatively short half-life. Found in both Radioactive and Frozen atmospheres, this gas is produced by the decay of other high-energy elements.
A reactive atmospheric gas found wherever there is organic life. Nitrogen is readily harvested from the atmospheres of Lush and Toxic planets.
An atmospheric gas found in the hostile conditions of gas giants. Methane is readily harvested from equipment deployed on gas worlds.

A chromatic metal, generated by fusion in the heart of a star. This Copper has been activated by the extreme conditions in which it was formed, and is highly valuable. Copper is found on planets orbiting yellow stars, and can be placed in a Refiner to create purified Chromatic Metal.

A chromatic metal, generated by fusion in the heart of a star. This Cadmium has been activated by the extreme conditions in which it was formed, and is highly valuable. Cadmium is found on planets orbiting red stars, and can be placed in a Refiner to create purified Chromatic Metal.

A chromatic metal, generated by fusion in the heart of a star. This Emeril has been activated by the extreme conditions in which it was formed, and is highly valuable. Emeril is found on planets orbiting green stars, and can be placed in a Refiner to create purified Chromatic Metal.

A chromatic metal, generated by fusion in the heart of a star. Indium is found on planets orbiting blue stars, and can be placed in a Refiner to create purified Chromatic Metal. This Indium has been activated by the extreme conditions in which it was formed, and is highly valuable.

A chromatic mineral, generated by fusion in the heart of a star. Quartzite is found on planets orbiting purple stars, and can be placed in a Refiner to create purified Chromatic Metal. This quartzite has been activated by the extreme conditions in which it was formed, and is highly valuable.

An oddly-glowing substance, harvested from the gills of Fungal Clusters. The host plant requires a toxic climate to thrive in the wild, but can be farmed in all environments with the aid of a Hydroponics Tray.

A beautiful blue crystal, this organic compound possesses both great hardiness and a shimmering translucence. It is harvested from the leaves of Frostwort. Frostwort requires frozen conditions to thrive in the wild, but can be farmed in all environments with the aid of a Hydroponics Tray.

A strange substance that seems to slowly shift the air around it. It is found in the roots of the Gamma Weed plant. Gamma Weed requires high background radiation to thrive in the wild, but can be farmed in all environments with the aid of a Hydroponics Tray.

Succulent, edible cactus flesh from the Echinocactus plant. As well as being juicy on the tongue, the flesh has many industrial uses. The Echinocactus thrives only on desert planets, but can be farmed in all environments with the aid of a Hydroponics Tray..

A powerful chemical that has resisted attempts at synthesis. It can be harvested from the bark of the Solar Vine. The vine requires a hot climate to thrive in the wild, but can be farmed in all environments with the aid of a Hydroponics Tray.

A beautiful gemstone, this prized product is the engorged, luminescent berry of the Star Bramble. The host plant requires lush conditions to thrive in the wild, but can be farmed in all environments with the aid of a Hydroponics Tray.

A glowing organic bulb, harvested from the Cave Marrow plant found growing underground. The Cave Marrow has proved resistant to domestication, and no farmable cultivars are known to exist. As such, marrow bulbs must be harvested by hand in the wild.
A rubbery, luminescent sac harvested from underwater Candle Kelp plants. Agricultural science has not yet tamed the Candle Kelp. As such, these sacs cannot be farmed.

A foul-smelling compound that can be harvested from the Gutrot Flower, or less desirably from the faecal matter of some species. Creatures can be fed to encourage the formation and deposition of faecium crystals.
A pulsating, foul smelling goop that builds up in poorly-maintained machinery. Skin contact is not advised.
An out of control mould growth that builds up in poorly-maintained machinery. Likely to be several different species of mould, merged together into one super-colony.
Handfuls of corroded metal, distorted by years of exposure to the harsh environment. Handle with care.
A heavy, oozing slime. It is moving gently, as if it has a heartbeat of its own. Nutrient source: unknown.
An unnaturally thick liquid of dubious colour. Its origins are impossible to fathom. Appears to have some mild magnetic properties.

Shredded fragments of a soft, grey metal. Its surface is porous, and when touched it oozes ever-so-slightly. Found in the creaking wreck of a derelict freighter. The space station Scrap Dealer may find this interesting...
An odourless, mineral-rich substance with a hexagonal crystalline structure, harvested from the faecal matter of a creature.
Conventional planetary metal, superheated and then held in a stabilised plasmatic form. Extracted from metallic terrain deposits using a Solar Ray. Enormously energetic.

A pattern, no more than a mere waveform, etched into the surface of a tiny metallic shard. This fragment of data represents a recording of the electrical impulses running across a neural network. Many fragments would be required to recreate any sensible experience. Generated by the interaction of the Animus Beam with a living target.

A pattern, no more than a mere waveform, etched into an ethereal shard of glass. This fragment of data represents a trace of the electrical impulses running across a neural network. Many fragments would be required to recreate any sensible experience. Released upon the destruction of a boundary horror.

A powdery desert soil, slick with the gland expressions of a colossal sandworm. Historically, some have regarded this dust as the divine parent of such worms. It smells curiously sweet. Cursed Dust gathers in the terrain deposits of planets blighted by titan worm activity.

Grey, dead, sparkling with life and colour, singing as it shimmers. This impossibly fine dust is the accumulated decay of time and memories. Collected from the fine layers it forms around hotspots in the loop. Of great value to Specialist Polo as they research the loop.

The echo of a genetic possibility, forgotten by evolution. It twitches with a wild energy. Extracted from a creature caught within a repeating circuit of time. Of great value to Specialist Polo as they research the loop.

When swarmer shells are completely obliterated, this syrupy metal remains. It has a cloying, coppery smell that clings to the throat. Pure corrupted ichor is always flowing, sluggishly folding its molecules over and over.
An incredibly fine powder derived from the blasted remains of comet fragments. No evidence of its original crystalline matrix remains. Comet fragments are located within deep-space asteroid belts

Torn fragments of old industrial components. Years of decay have left it pocked by exotic oxides and faintly irradiated. This material requires deep processing before it can be recycled into new components. Salvaged from the creaking wreck of an abandoned space hulk.

Though apparently inorganic, the molecular makeup of these fibres has been drastically changed by exposure to both cosmic radiation and novel viral proteins. Harvested from a deep-space biohazard site.

A prefabricated circuit board, designed for flexible use in a large range of technology components. The module features an integrated nanite processor, allowing it to be quickly configured for a wide variety of uses.

A sinister shard of purple glass, salvaged from the destroyed remains of Sentinel machinery. Its walls are thin, and it may be broken down to access valuable Sentinel components. Select in the Inventory (INVENTORY) and shatter with FE_ALT1.
A highly sprung motor arm salvaged from inside of a Sentinel patrol unit. It occasionally twitches, as if experiencing the echo of combat.

The functional core of a Sentinel quadruped unit, but warped beyond all recognition. The entire machine is infested with a crystalline material that pulses wildy upon inspection. A close analysis reveals the machinery itself appears to have been reconfigured, stretching and warping into a whole new form, writhing in the presence of these radiant shards of glass.
This complex mechanical unit was once the central combustion chamber at the heart of a Sentinel Hardframe unit. Though now cool to the touch, it still glows with a sinister red heat...

Shifting nanite clusters sewn together with a pugneum filament, this circuit is painfully hot to the touch. A sinister purple light leaks from deep within its wiring, changing in intensity as it watches its holder.

The brain stem of a brood mother, pulled from its malignant corpse. This is a valuable trophy, signifying victory in the quest to purge the infestations of the vile brood. Turn it over to an envoy of the Mercenaries Guild to mark your triumph.

The central processing unit of a Sentinel interceptor ship. The circuitry writhes microscopically, constantly rearranging itself as it scans for anomalies. A vital component for any entity wishing to construct their own Pilot Interface for a Sentinel Interceptor. Status: VOLATILE

A pane of watchful g l a s s, retrieved from the smoking remains of the corrupted swarm's Dissonance Resonators. It emits more light than it reflects, casting a faint purple hue on its surroundings. Highly sought after for salvage operations, as it can be used to bypass the security systems of key Sentinel ship technologies.

A fragment of glassy lifeforce, chipped from a larger formation. Dynamic intermolecular binding gives the shard a strangely flexible, sinewy quality. It writhes gently, almost as if it were seeking something... Highly sought after for salvage operations, as it can be used to bypass the security systems of key Sentinel ship technologies.
A shard of pure crystalised Tritium. Select in the Inventory (INVENTORY) and crack open with FE_ALT1.

An eye of living stone: waiting, watching. A relic left by a slumbering guardian, keeping sentry over ancient creature burial grounds. Warning: Disturbing the eye may disturb the slumber of living stone guardians. Ensure re-animated guardians are defeated before storing this relic in the home.

A stabilised poison gland extracted from a terrestrial urchin. The host-urchin is actually a colony of smaller proto-creatures, a formation built on years of slow growth and cooperation. Of use both medicinally and as a delicacy in some riskier cuisines. Can be sold at a Galactic Trade Terminal.

A supersymmetric particle cluster created by divergent super-gravitational forces. A micro-rift is created as they form, and extraction of the orb prompts a localised reality weakening. Sentinel forces will respond to stablise any such anomaly. Can be sold at a Galactic Trade Terminal.
A pulsating jellied orb, this gooey sphere is warm to the touch. Its stench triggers a primal fear in mortal beings, a deep-seated gnawing that begs you to drop it and flee.

A rare and highly valuable cluster of storm crystals. These crystalline structures thrive in stormy conditions, and naturally attract lightning strikes, becoming spectacularly luminescent when ionised. Exclusively found on extreme weather planets.

Born in the hearts of enormous glowing molluscs found deep underwater. Unlike most pearls, this sample is no unliving calcite. Some trace of the mother-clam's consciousness remains within the gem, giving it a lingering, haunting beauty.

Formed in the incredible, high-pressure furnace of planetary cores, these rich mineral deposits have an almost glass-like quality. Has a wide variety of industrial uses, taking advantage of both its mineral content and its extreme strength under pressure.
A highly-pressurised fleshy orb. One can feel it push back when touched, a flash of bioluminescence stirring in the inky black core of this mysterious object.

The eye is cold, almost frozen, to the touch. Nonetheless, it is impossible to escape the feeling it is somehow still alive. Extended exposure is not recommended. Do not stare back into the eye. Do not stare back. Do not stare back.
A key of some weight, this aged piece of wrought iron must belong in a nearby lock...
A strange forked key, glowing with an ultraviolet light. Despite its primitive appearance, Exosuit scanning systems reveal traces of nanite foam upon its teeth.
The salvageable heart of some ancient technology. Unreadable in its current form. These databanks can be spent at a Construction Research Unit and used to research new Construction Blueprints.

Edible product much beloved by the Gek. Allows beaked traders to release delightfully scented packets of gas for a prolonged period of time. GekNip gas packets are considered an art form, and the truest representation of the Gek soul.
A pungent bud harvested from the NipNip plant, often used to produce Gek Nip.
The metallic shell of a disconnected electronic lifeform that was too distant from its kind to be refreshed with a new entity. Highly prized by all species, not least its own.
Device used by the Korvax for the storage of historical and cultural information.

Several spools of star silk. Star silk is woven on enormous solar looms in orbit around trading planets. Cosmic ray impact triggers the pattern of the weave, which can then be used in advanced material processing.

Reversed-engineered from a captured space station core, these unlicensed circuits are used in a wide range of black- and grey-market technologies. Purchase is illegal at nearly all galactic trade terminals. Regular supply is only available within outlaw systems. Selling banned goods into commercially-regulated space may be highly profitable.

A tainted metallic shell. Though damaged, its core components can be recycled into valuable materials. Harvested from the decaying remains of a collapsing space hulk. This has been processed at a deep-space outpost, and can be sold on the open market.

Still sealed, this is an extremely valuable piece of industrial salvage. Harvested from the decaying remains of a collapsing space hulk. This has been processed at a deep-space outpost, and can be sold on the open market.

Full of heavy metals and precious synthetics, this is a valuable piece of industrial salvage. Harvested from the decaying remains of a collapsing space hulk. This has been processed at a deep-space outpost, and can be sold on the open market.

A valuable vacuum condensate harvested from the remains of a shattered comet. This has been processed at a deep-space outpost, and can be sold on the open market.
A folded mass of pathogenic proteins, harvested from a deep-space biohazard. This has been processed at a deep-space outpost, and can be sold on the open market.
A glutinous fleshy lump, harvested from a deep-space biohazard. Ingestion is not recommended. This has been processed at a deep-space outpost, and can be sold on the open market.

The coiled remains of a Hungering Tendril's digestive tract. Though its meaty walls still convulse, there is surely no way for a fresh tendril to regrow from these meagre scraps... Such specialist offal is rarely traded on the Galactic Exchange and is thus highly valuable.
The fragile embryo of a Hungering Tendril, still dripping with mucal butter. It wails and recoils when touched. May be extracted from embryotic sacs with the aid of a Visceral Synthesiser.
Unusual surface interactions cause this liquid to quickly split into small, perfect, spheres. Light refracted through one such sphere splits into colours beyond description. Of unknown origin.

Shifting nanite clusters sewn together with a pugneum filament, this circuit is painfully hot to the touch. The purple light that leaks from within its wiring has softened, as if it has become less hostile. Previously embedded within a Sentinel Walker, this semi-organic computer has been altered by both Iteration: Tethys and a Messenger of the Atlas.

The central processing unit of a Sentinel interceptor ship. The circuitry appears stable, pulsing with a regular electrical heartbeat. It no longer reacts angrily to my presence. Status: DOCILE Install this unit in a disabled Sentinel ship to unlock its vestigial cockpit and enable manual piloting.
The Seed is an echo of life, the last reverberations of a living being. This sentience was fused with a lattice of Atlantideum, as though it had germinated together with the crystal.

Fire dances across the scales of this impossible marine being. Its starlit eyes stare back at you with a meaning far deeper than any fish should know. As they stare, the world around you fades away. The sound of water fills your ears. It wants to be free. You want to be free...

A highly refined food product, created in the Nutrient Processor. It has both the identifying shapes and aromas of an actual food item, in stark contrast with conventional nutrition paste or pellets. Food such as this can be highly valuable.
A piece of seafood, created in the Nutrient Processor. Food such as this can be highly valuable. Can be consumed as it stands or subjected to further processing.

items.d: "A voice like honey from a mouth of mucus."
"Its tentacles that glitter like wisps of golden hair, but sting with the fire of thousand suns."
"Territorial, ancient, furious to be caught. The king of the sea."
"A true titan of the depths. Nothing compares for sheer mass."
"Its perfect crystalline form glistens with a emerald light that changes the soul of all those whose eyes fall upon it."
"A true error of the deep; its hungry bite corrupts your blood, filling your body with a spurting corrosive bile."
"Robbed of flesh and stripped of colour by acid seas, the bonefish swims on regardless."
"Seemingly weak and fragile at the surface, these giant jaws have swallowed alive many an unwary soul who ventured into their abyssal home..."
"A thousand eyes erupt from its soft flesh: a never-ending cycle of rising, blinking, sinking, and re-emergence."
"Its wings beat slowly as it sails though the poisoned seas, a drifter with no place of rest, no end to their journey."
"A pale blue glow surrounds it as it drifts through the water - a warning to all those who would come too close..."
"Polymorphic, twisting, always in motion; its body a constant whirr of shifting forms and ripping teeth."
"Its glittering shell is practically unbreakable, a material of pure perfection."
"Impossible to see with mortal eyes as it flashes through the water under boiling, cloudless skies."
"A dark cloud follows this creature, and dreams of doom await all those who touch it."
"Heart of stone and fins of iron, this creature lives on where all else falters."
"A living snowflake: frozen solid yet still alive, its tentacles a fractal recursion."
"A name only spoken in whispers, its pale body a illusion that flickers beneath the moonlit waves."
"A heart that beats but once a hour, a heart that sees faster life spawn and die, spawn and die, spawn and die..."
"None would believe the scale of this beast: its colossal shell, its enormous slimy foot. None, except those who have seen it..."
"A creature of dreams, only visible where the light refracts through its soft, perfect jelly."
"When hunting, can dissolve into a thin dark cloud, impossible to track, impossible to see coming..."
"A powerful, muscular body and teeth like razors, these gentle giants protect smaller creatures from predators."
"The old man of the sea; scarred, blinded, still swimming on..."
"A delicate creature, a fragment of the past that lives on in the water."
"The many-mouths arise from the darkness of the ocean; the many-mouths hunger for their home in the sand..."
"A relic of another age, a fusion of life and stone that refuses to die."
"The apex of marine predation, a perfect killing machine. Beware."
"Deep feeling swims in those watery eyestalks, the thoughtful intelligence of a true ancient."
"It slides beneath the waves; it slides between the ears; it slides within the folds, and swims forever in your dreams."
"Streamlined, deadly, perfect: the terror of the deep."
"So young and fragile, despite its years beneath the waves. And yet thousands more years must pass before it joins the great herd in the stars..."
"The geometry of its impossible body folds within itself, a writhing thread of flesh and spacetime."
"Brilliantly ablaze, its surface a perfect liquid sun..."
"Both alive and not alive; at once a creature, a mineral, and a moment from another time..."
"So few things survive in waters such as these... so that which thrives should strike fear into the heart of any thinking being."
"Listen to these words: Do not allow this egg to hatch. Cast it back into the sea."
"Shell and claw of perfect crystal, eyestalks aglow with purple rage; a being displaced from another reality and cast here as crab."
"Its song resonates across time and space, calling to its home in the endless black above. One day, it will rise and return to its home among the stars."
"On the surface or below the waves, the vessel hungers, the vessel feeds..."

EXP_CURIO3: A glitching, pulsing data unit. It does not seem to belong in this reality. The cube gives the impression of a silent scream, the frozen cries of hundreds of lost minds trapped within.
STATION_KEY: A portable data drive containing the AI override codes for a Space Station Core. The importance of the station AI core ensures that such keys are both highly regulated and extremely profitable on the black market.
REP_TOKEN: A counterfeit starship registration document. This digital signature is guaranteed free of previous crimes or misdemeanors. Can be used to reset any negative faction standing records at a Space Station Core.
NAV_DATA: Encoded navigation data. This highly portable data unit contains all relevant cartographical information for a planetary region. May be traded with a Cartographer aboard a Space Station in exchange for usable star charts.
NAV_DATA_DROP: Encoded navigation data which, when properly decrypted, will reveal the location of a Drop Pod containing an Exosuit Inventory Upgrade. Select the coordinates in the inventory and use Plot Route (FE_ALT1) to pin the location in your Exosuit display.
LOG_KEY: A fragment of the encryption override sequence for a freighter's emergency log. Several parts of the sequence may be required to gain full access to recorded data.
POLICE_TOKEN: A token, entitling the bearer to support from the system authorities in dealing with pirate attacks.
FACT_TOKEN: A portable data unit, compatible with most planetary fabricator facilities. Once access has been gained to a central control terminal, the Override Unit can divert the facilities resources towards researching new product recipes.
FRIG_TOKEN: A technology module harvested from the remains of a large interstellar starship. May be collected from freighter crashsites or salvaged during frigate expeditions. Useless in its current form, a Research Station aboard your freighter may be able to convert it into useable technology.
FREI_INV_TOKEN: A technology module harvested from the remains of an abandoned freighter found floating in space. May also be salvaged during frigate expeditions. Pre-packed nano-expanders fill out this portable unit and graft it to an existing freighter, increasing its inventory capacity. Apply at your freighter's Upgrade Terminal.
WEAP_INV_TOKEN: A flexible upgrade circuit, compatible with all person Multi-Tools. This module can be wired into a Multi-Tool at a Space Station Multi-Tool Upgrade Rack, granting the user more space in the Multi-Tool's internal layout to add further upgrades or technology specialisations.
SUIT_INV_TOKEN: An advanced survival technology module that allows expansion of a user's Exosuit Storage. Pre-packed nano-expanders create stablised sub-warp voids within the Exosuit, increasing its inventory capacity. Apply this augmentation at the Exosuit upgrade terminal on board a Space Station.
ALIEN_INV_TOKEN: An additional storage nodule for Sentient starships. Upon hatching, the parasite inside this sac is grafted upon the vessel, exchanging the use of its cavernous innards for vital nutrients from the host. Use FE_ALT1 to trigger growth and begin the hatching process.
ALIEN_TECHBOX: A writhing sac of genetic fluid, designed to foster the creation of new bio-infused technology for a sentient starship. The embryo will grow into bio-technology upgrade. Begin biogenesis with FE_ALT1.
TECHBOX: The shattered remnants of an expired traveller. It whispers, an unknowable name deep within its fibres. The memory will manifest as an important technology upgrade to aid you on your travels. Absorb this memory with FE_ALT1.
INVBOX: The shattered remnants of an expired traveller. It whispers, an unknowable name deep within its fibres. The memory will manifest as an inventory expansion to aid you on your travels. Absorb this memory with FE_ALT1.
TRA_CURIO1: A metal statuette of a creature with a coin placed in its beak. Popular with many traders who see it as an emblem of fair commerce and peace.
WAR_CURIO1: A small wooden icon carved into the shape of a Sentinel drone. Used by warriors to enter a temporary trance-like state that eliminates their kind's need for sleep.
WAR_CURIO2: Largely ceremonial weapon. A vital part of Vy'keen tradition and culture.
TRA_ALLOY1: A packed crate of carbon nanotubes. These tiny but incredibly strong tubes are required in the construction of tiny but incredibly strong scientific components.
TRA_ALLOY2: A hopper of self-repairing Heridium. It looks fresh. Used in the creation of scientific components. Self-repairing heridium is particularly useful for deployment in remote facilities, where maintenance opportunities may be limited or deadly.
TRA_ALLOY3: Several bottles of optical solvent. The liquid in these bottles is used to wash away surplus light that may otherwise cause decay in scientific components.
TRA_ALLOY4: A specially manufactured container of five-dimensional tori. Highly specific materials are required to construct shapes in extra dimensions. These tori are used to contain the strong fields generated in the manufacture of scientific components.
TRA_ALLOY5: A densely layered package of superconducting fibres. Powerful, flexible, and water-resistant; the controlled magnetic weave of these fibres is vital in the creation of many scientific components.
TRA_COMMODITY1: A crate packed with hard drives, each of which contain vast amounts of decrypted user data. Individually of low value, taken together these repositories can be processed and scanned for valuable data. This processing occurs in systems with advanced material economies.
TRA_COMMODITY3: Several canisters of comet droplets. An elaborate trading name for chunks of meteorite, these rocks are nonetheless extremely valuable to the advanced material economies that can process them.
TRA_COMMODITY4: A packed crate of ion spheres. These delicate glass spheres house a small-scale replica of the upper atmosphere. Sparkly and hypnotic to look at, these baubles are also of importance in the manufacture of advanced material alloys.
TRA_COMMODITY5: A bundle of precisely calibrated teleport coordinators. These pin-prick sized circuits are vital to the delicate process of inserting reinforcing material into advanced alloys. They can also aid long-distance sales efforts.
TRA_COMPONENT1: Several huge cogs. Sturdy, well-made metal gears. While not advanced technology themselves, they're a vital component in countless pieces of high-tech machinery all over the galaxy.
TRA_COMPONENT2: Wrapped and greased pistons, ready for shipping. High-tech components frequently require rapidly moving parts, or high-endurance motors. Without specially coated pistons, the failure rate of such parts would be significantly higher.
TRA_COMPONENT3: A crate of mesh decouplers. The creation of high-tech components often involves accidental mesh-coupling. These decouplers are particularly powerful, being able to deploy six prongs simultaneously.
TRA_COMPONENT4: Packed and separated data containers for holographic crankshafts. Real crankshafts are frequently too large, noisy or hard-to-maintain for use in delicate machines. When faced with such a situation, high-tech manufacturers turn to these holographic substitutes.
TRA_COMPONENT5: A large crate of high-capacity vector compressors. The creation of interstellar drives often requires dimensions to be condensed and then re-rendered. Such high-tech component manufacture would not be possible without industrial-grade compressors such as these.
TRA_ENERGY1: A crate packed with spark canisters. Many industrial and mining processes have considerable power demands. A counterpart to the slow release of a battery, spark canisters are able to meet these demands instantaneously.
TRA_ENERGY2: A packet of well-isolated industrial batteries. Heavy-duty batteries are required to power deep level miningoperations. These highly durable sources can last for weeks, even in the extremes of heat and pressure found kilometres underground.
TRA_ENERGY3: Several packets of ohmic gel. Power-hungry mining operations are fraught with danger. Ohmic gel helps keep rapidly moving parts both insulated and lubricated.
TRA_ENERGY4: Corrosion-resistant barrels of an experimental power fluid. One barrel of this highly volatile concoction is enough to power a space station for weeks on end. Particularly valued by mining economies.
TRA_ENERGY5: A slightly glowing bundle of fusion cores. Power source, engine, high-capacity heater. A fusion core is the ultimate in deep-space power generation. Highly valued by mining economies looking to make their asteroid colonies more self-sufficient.
TRA_EXOTICS1: A loose collection of recycled pheromone bottles. Vast quantities of pheromones are produced and distributed every day. This has spawned a lucrative trading opportunity for those willing to deal with the waste products. These glass jars have been thoroughly scrubbed and should pose no threat to the carrier.
TRA_EXOTICS2: A parcel of neutron microscopes. Scientific economies produce and consume large numbers of microscopes. However, some have slight defects that render them unsuitable for precision work. These are still a trading opportunity, in that they can be sold to those unable to tell the difference.
TRA_EXOTICS3: A jumbled box of instability injectors. Grand experiments often require a large number of variables to be changed in a very short period of time. An instability injector provides such a service. They can also be used to create chaos in market systems; such unethical behaviour represents an excellent trading opportunity.
TRA_EXOTICS4: A vat of preserved organic piping. Still warm. To avoid difficult ethical problems, many labs grow their test subjects on a component level. The leftovers can be profitable in trading economies with relaxed medical regulations.
TRA_EXOTICS5: A box of fresh neural ducts. Neural ducts are temporary inserts designed for a brief boost of concentration and productivity. Useful everywhere, these are highly valued in trading economies where competition between workers is fierce.
TRA_MINERALS1: Several tonnes of dirt. Leftover dirt from mining operations. Residual metals can be extracted by specialists in manufacturing economies with the time and equipment to sift through it.
TRA_MINERALS2: Large jars full of pyrite grease. A fat solution with a high mineral content. This grease is highly valued by manufacturing economies, where it's used to keep large machinery oiled and glistening.
TRA_MINERALS3: A crate of bromide salt. The result of an extensive distillation and evaporation process, the bromide salt vats feed hungry factories in manufacturing systems.
TRA_MINERALS4: A sack full of polychromatic zirconium crystals. These crystals produce lenses of dazzling colour and near-indestructible hardness. Highly valuable in manufacturing economies.
TRA_MINERALS5: A neatly wrapped parcel of re-latticed arc crystals. Extremely rare mineral formations, arc crystals are in high demand in manufacturing economies, where their hardness and conductivity is vital to several industrial processes. They also make alluring (if dangerous) jewellery.
TRA_TECH1: A collection of salvaged circuitry. Power generation economies go through vast numbers of high-tech components. As such, the demand is present even for highly damaged circuits, to be scavenged for parts or just plugged wholesale into low-quality power cores.
TRA_TECH2: Several large bars of welding soap. Used in power generation systems to heat-clean metal diodes before they're fused into batteries.
TRA_TECH3: A reinforced crate of ion capacitors. These supercapacitors have an incredibly high energy density. In great demand in power generation economies.
TRA_TECH4: A container of positioning units and associated wiring. These APS units can be used to turn virtually any technology into a self-navigating system. Highly valuable in power generation economies, where they're used to remove conductive organic hands from the manufacturing process.
TRA_TECH5: Several large quantum accelerator units. Capable of propelling matter at unmeasurable speeds, these units are particularly important in power generation economies, where they're used to compress the energy stored in high-grade batteries.

The first worm split the sky like black lightning as it leapt overhead. Worm by worm, they rose from the desert. Migrating. Every storm season, we each hope to be chosen. We arrange ourselves in lines across the desert, arms lifted to the sky. Anyone may enter the maw. We are all equal under the great worms.'
WORMSCROLL1: Ancient words are carved into this living document. They read: 'The worm lord towers above the dusty earth; its flesh becomes the sky. Our pathetic shells cannot follow, cannot reach its height, cannot reach its depths. We offer ourselves to the ground. We beg our sacrifice accepted.'
WORMSCROLL2: Ancient words are carved into this living document. They read: 'The dust was choking. Our eyes reddened and watered. But the truth was inescapable. The veins of the Atlas had surfaced.'
WORMSCROLL3: Ancient words are carved into this living document. They read: 'Now with every storm we beg to be chosen; Arms to the sky, faces to the dirt, calling out with all we have! When heavy raindrops hit the earth, the veins of Atlas answer. The rapture of our consumption is beyond words.'
WORMSCROLL4: Ancient words are carved into this living document. They read: 'We tumble as it swallows, but grip the slick walls as best we can - Oh! - to reach the gizzard still awake. Breathe it deeply! How our lungs gurgle! The slime clogs our noses and stings our eyes, though in this warm darkness, we are already blind.'
WORMSCROLL5: Ancient words are carved into this living document. They read: 'Curse the agony of regurgitation, Curse this this feeble flesh that still confines me! My brethren were reborn, rising from the blessed dust as fresh tendrils. Glistening capillaries to the great veins, slithering away into the sand. I will be patient. Until the next storm.'

ROGUE_G_STONE1: A memory is burned into this strange material, an echo of another lifetime... "The leviathan was like nothing I've ever seen. So vast as to blot out the sun. I wanted it. I deserve to have it! It will be mine. But it resisted, would not come quietly. It wailed and it wailed as the infra-knife carved into its meat. It almost took me down with it. Perhaps it has. Perhaps..."
ROGUE_G_STONE2: A memory is burned into this strange material, an echo of another lifetime... "The same nightmare chases me: a wail fills my cockpit, the dashboard controls gummed with blood. I have given up sleep. I pulse past blurred stars. And then there it was: majestic, drifting in the ocean of space. Something inside me burns for it. I must have it. Its great fin flexed toward my ship, and my hull was gone..."
ROGUE_G_STONE3: A memory is burned into this strange material, an echo of another lifetime... "Today should have been the day. Their hour was at hand. It must be mine. They are like nothing I've ever seen. Everything was prepared. But it moved faster than I thought possible. As though it knew where I would fly, before I knew it myself. A great tentacle hugged my ship, my cockpit - pressing my suit down to the bone. This suit will be my grave."
ROGUE_G_STONE4: A memory is burned into this strange material, an echo of another lifetime... "The chase is over, and I have lost. The giants will endure, and I will end. As I plummeted from the sky, I saw another ship falling alongside mine. Then another, and another. I may have imagined it. The misfiring of a dying mind... Those creatures were so beautiful. But it is all ended now. They will haunt my thoughts no longer."
ROGUE_G_STONE5: A memory is burned into this strange material, an echo of another lifetime... "I came face-to-face with a creature more beautiful and bizarre than anything I have ever seen. Despite no discernible eyes, I do not believe it is blind. It was huge, glorious, serene. But then - with a flick of its tentacles, it was gone. I have thought of nothing else since. I can only think of the whale. whale. whale. wail."

FUELPROD3: Hyper-compressed carbon, this substance's dense nanostructure makes it highly valuable as both an energy source and a technology component. Synthesised from Condensed Carbon.
LANDPROD3: A highly-prized metal product, this rare element is used in the manufacture of several advanced technologies. Metal is highly reactive and quickly bonds to exposed skin. User is advised to handle with extreme caution. Synthesised from Magnetised Ferrite.
CAVEPROD3: A novel molecular form of Cobalt, requiring very high energy levels to create. Natural occurrence is extremely rare. Synthesised from Ionised Cobalt.
WATERPROD3: A tightly-bonded form of Chlorine. Rigidly-packed molecules offer unrivalled conductivity. Not known to form spontaneously: creation requires highly-focused energy inputs. Synthesised from Chlorine.
CATAPROD3: Sodium is typically highly stable, but certain configurations retain the reactivity of its component ions. User is advised to wear Hazardous Material Gauntlets before handling. Synthesised from Sodium.
OXYPROD3: A para-magnetic form of Oxygen, this rare substance has much to offer in the production of advanced technologies. Requires conversion prior to input into Life Support systems. Direct inhalation is NOT recommended. Synthesised from Oxygen.
OXY_CRAFT: A specialist technology component. This small device can rapidly change the gaseous environment within a device, handling conditions from total vacuum to pure oxygen atmospheres.
WATER_CRAFT: A specialist technology component, vital to the complex internals of modern laser systems. This light-scattering device takes advantage of the unique optical properties of stabilised and polished salt, to both slow and refract passing photons.
CAVE_CRAFT: A specialist optical component. Employing a polished cobalt surface, this mirror is able to selectively filter different wavelengths of light, changing its reflective pattern based on nearby magnetic fields.
CATA_CRAFT: An advanced circuit component. The refined sodium electrode within its vacuum tube gives this diode specialist surge-protection capabilities.
PRODFUEL1: Stablised and secure life support filtration gas. Easily assembled from Oxygen and Ferrite Dust. Offers an efficient method for long-term life support power.
POWERCELL2: Powerful energy storage unit. Used in a wide variety of defensive and hazard protection systems. Constructed from Ionised Cobalt and Pure Ferrite, and occasionally found in cylindrical metal containers.
