hint.FUEL1: Harvest Carbon from plants using the Mining Laser. Fire the laser with ATTACK. WARNING: Excess harvesting may attract attention from Sentinel drones.
hint.FUEL2: Condensed Carbon is found in crystal form on most planets. Locate carbon crystals with the Scanner (SCAN). Large deposits may require use of an Advanced Mining Laser. Condensed Carbon can be created from Carbon in a Refiner.
hint.OXYGEN: Oxygen can be harvested from red plants found on all planets. Locate oxygen-rich plants with the Scanner (SCAN). Oxygen can also be gathered from some hazardous plants, as well as identified in general flora with the Analysis Visor.
hint.LAUNCHSUB: Di-hydrogen is found in crystal form on most planets. Locate di-hydrogen crystals with the Scanner (SCAN). Large deposits may require use of an Advanced Mining Laser.
hint.LAUNCHSUB2: Create Deuterium by processing Di-hydrogen with Tritium or Silicate Powder in a multi-input refiner.
hint.ROCKETSUB: Tritium is abundant in asteroid fields. Find asteroid fields in rings around planets or at intervals in interstellar flight. Scan (SCAN) to search for tritium-rich asteroids.
hint.LAND1: Harvest Ferrite Dust from small rocks using the Mining Laser. Fire the laser with ATTACK. WARNING: Excess harvesting may attract attention from Sentinel drones.
hint.LAND2: Create Pure Ferrite in a Refiner by processing ferrite dust. Some large rocks can be mined for Pure Ferrite directly with an Advanced Mining Laser.
hint.LAND3: Create Magnetised Ferrite in a Refiner by processing pure ferrite.
hint.SAND1: Extract from the earth of any planet with a Terrain Manipulator.
hint.CATALYST1: Sodium is harvested from yellow plants found on all planets. Locate sodium-rich plants with the Scanner (SCAN).
hint.CATALYST2: Sodium Nitrate is created from Sodium in a Refiner Sodium Nitrate is also found in crystal form. Locate sodium nitrate crystals with the Scanner (SCAN). Mining requires use of an Advanced Mining Laser.
hint.CAVE1: Cobalt is readily extracted from subterranean rock deposits. Locate natural cave entrances. WARNING: many caves contain hazardous flora.
hint.CAVE2: Ionised Cobalt is created from Cobalt in a Refiner. Locate Cobalt underground. Locate natural cave entrances. WARNING: many caves contain hazardous flora.
hint.WATER1: Salt is readily extracted from underwater rock deposits. Increase marine efficiency by upgrading the Exosuit Aeration Membrane or by refilling oxygen supplies from Kelp Sacs.
hint.WATER2: Chlorine is created from Salt in a Refiner. Chlorine can be mined directly from large underwater deposits. Mining requires use of an Advanced Mining Laser.
hint.WATERPLANT: Cyto-Phosphates are readily extracted from underwater plants. Increase marine efficiency by upgrading the Exosuit Aeration Membrane, refilling oxygen supplies from Kelp Sacs, or travelling in a Nautilon Submarine.
hint.YELLOW2: Copper is mined from large deposits using the Terrain Manipulator. Find copper deposits with the Analysis Visor. Copper deposits are found on planets orbiting yellow stars.
hint.RED2: Cadmium is mined from large deposits using the Terrain Manipulator. Find cadmium deposits with the Analysis Visor. Cadmium deposits are found on planets orbiting red stars.
hint.GREEN2: Emeril is mined from large deposits using the Terrain Manipulator. Find emeril deposits with the Analysis Visor. Emeril deposits are found on planets orbiting green stars.
hint.BLUE2: Indium is mined from large deposits using the Terrain Manipulator. Find indium deposits with the Analysis Visor. Indium deposits are found on planets orbiting blue stars.
hint.PURPLE2: Quartzite is mined from large deposits using the Terrain Manipulator. Find quartzite deposits with the Analysis Visor. Quartzite deposits are found on planets orbiting purple stars.
hint.STELLAR2: Chromatic Metal is created in a Refiner from the stellar metals: Copper, Cadmium, Emeril and Indium. The rarer the stellar metal, the more Chromatic Metal it will produce. Find stellar metal deposits on planets using the Analysis Visor.
hint.TECHFRAG: A strange and potent substance, nanite clusters are found where the boundaries of the universe weaken. Seek abandoned buildings and other sites of interest.
hint.LUSH1: Paraffinium is found primarily on worlds with a tropical environment. Typically found in large deposits and located with the Analysis Visor. Common ferrite rocks may yield Paraffinium after inspection with an Analysis Visor. Can be refined from other terrain elements.
hint.DUSTY1: Pyrite is found primarily on worlds with a desert environment. Typically found in large deposits and located with the Analysis Visor. Common ferrite rocks may yield Pyrite after inspection with an Analysis Visor. Can be refined from other terrain elements.
hint.TOXIC1: Ammonia is found primarily on worlds with a toxic environment. Typically found in large deposits and located with the Analysis Visor. Common ferrite rocks may yield Ammonia after inspection with an Analysis Visor. Can be refined from other terrain elements.
hint.RADIO1: Uranium is found primarily on worlds with a radioactive environment. Typically found in large deposits and located with the Analysis Visor. Common ferrite rocks may yield Uranium after inspection with an Analysis Visor. Can be refined from other terrain elements.
hint.COLD1: Dioxite is found primarily on worlds with a frozen environment. Typically found in large deposits and located with the Analysis Visor. Common ferrite rocks may yield Dioxite after inspection with an Analysis Visor. Can be refined from other terrain metals.
hint.HOT1: Phosphorus is found primarily on worlds with a scorched environment. Typically found in large deposits and located with the Analysis Visor. Common ferrite rocks may yield Phosphorus after inspection with an Analysis Visor. Can be refined from other terrain metals.
hint.LAVA1: Basalt is found primarily on worlds with a volcanic environment. Typically found in large deposits and located with the Analysis Visor. Common ferrite rocks may yield Basalt after inspection with an Analysis Visor. Basalt may be refined from Magnetised Ferrite and terrain metals from other high-temperature worlds.
hint.WATERWORLD1: Lithium is typically found in large deposits or harvested from common mineral formations after inspection with an Analysis Visor. Locate such deposits on ocean planets.
hint.GASGIANT1: Crystallised Helium is a supercooled chemical extract, typically found in large deposits or extracted from smaller mineral formations after inspection with an Analysis Visor. Extracted from deposits formed in the hostile conditions of gas giants.
hint.CREATURE1: Mordite is a gelatinous organic material harvested from the corpses of living beings. Extraction involves the death of the organism. It is possible to grow mordite given the right environment and correct host plant. Seek advice from an Agricultural Specialist.
hint.ROBOT1: A dark, liquid glass, Pugneum is extracted from the remains of Sentinels. Engage Sentinel forces in combat to release Pugneum from their shells.
hint.ROBOT2: This ethereal substance spills from the bodies of corrupted Sentinels as they fall. Engage corrupted Sentinel forces in combat to release Atlantideum from their shells, or harvest it from the crystals that litter their foul worlds.
hint.ASTEROID1: Silver is a valuable interstellar trading mineral, most commonly mined from asteroids. Occasionally found in underground planetary deposits.
hint.ASTEROID2: Gold is a valuable interstellar trading mineral, most commonly mined from asteroids. Occasionally found in underground planetary deposits.
hint.ASTEROID3: Platinum is a rare interstellar trading mineral, mined from asteroids. Very occasionally found in underground planetary deposits.
hint.GAS1: Sulphurine is a pungent atmospheric gas. High concentrations are extremely hazardous to organic life. With the aid of an Atmosphere Harvester, can be extracted from the atmospheres of Scorched and Barren planets.
hint.GAS2: Radon is a colourless, odourless gas with a relatively short half-life. With the aid of an Atmosphere Harvester, can be extracted from the atmospheres of Radioactive and Frozen planets.
hint.GAS3: Nitrogen is a reactive atmospheric gas found wherever there is organic life. With the aid of an Atmosphere Harvester, can be extracted from the atmospheres of Lush and Toxic planets.
hint.GAS4: Methane is a hazardous gas found in the stormy atmosphere of a gas giant. With the aid of an Atmosphere Harvester, can be extracted from the furious clouds that blanket these worlds.
hint.EX_YELLOW: Activated Copper is created by the harsh environmental conditions on Extreme Weather Planets. Find copper deposits with the Analysis Visor and mine using the Terrain Manipulator. Copper deposits are found on planets orbiting yellow stars.
hint.EX_RED: Activated Cadmium is created by the harsh environmental conditions on Extreme Weather Planets. Find cadmium deposits with the Analysis Visor and mine using the Terrain Manipulator. Cadmium deposits are found on planets orbiting red stars.
hint.EX_GREEN: Activated Emeril is created by the harsh environmental conditions on Extreme Weather Planets. Find emeril deposits with the Analysis Visor and mine using the Terrain Manipulator. Emeril deposits are found on planets orbiting green stars.
hint.EX_BLUE: Activated Indium is created by the harsh environmental conditions on Extreme Weather Planets. Find indium deposits with the Analysis Visor and mine using the Terrain Manipulator. Indium deposits are found on planets orbiting blue stars.
hint.EX_PURPLE: Activated Quartzite is created by the harsh environmental conditions on Extreme Weather Planets. Find quartzite deposits with the Analysis Visor and mine using the Terrain Manipulator. Quartzite deposits are found on planets orbiting purple stars.
hint.PLANT_TOXIC: Fungal Mould is harvested from the gills of Fungal Clusters. The host plant grows wild in a toxic climate, but can be farmed in all environments with the aid of a Hydroponics Tray.
hint.PLANT_SNOW: Frost Crystals are harvested from the leaves of Frostwort. The host plant grows wild in a frozen climate, but can be farmed in all environments with the aid of a Hydroponics Tray.
hint.PLANT_RADIO: Gamma Root is harvested from the roots of the Gamma Weed plant. The host plant grows wild in a radioactive climate, but can be farmed in all environments with the aid of a Hydroponics Tray.
hint.PLANT_DUST: Cactus Flesh is harvested from the flesh of the Echinocactus plant The host plant grows wild in a barren climate, but can be farmed in all environments with the aid of a Hydroponics Tray.
hint.PLANT_HOT: Solanium is harvested from the bark of the Solar Vine. The host plant grows wild in a scorched climate, but can be farmed in all environments with the aid of a Hydroponics Tray.
hint.PLANT_LUSH: Star Bulbs are harvested from the engorged, luminescent berry of the Star Bramble. The host plant grows wild in a lush climate, but can be farmed in all environments with the aid of a Hydroponics Tray.
hint.PLANT_CAVE: Marrow Bulbs are harvested from the Cave Marrow plant found growing underground. Locate natural cave entrances or create your own with the Terrain Manipulator. WARNING: many caves contain hazardous flora.
hint.PLANT_WATER: Kelp Sacs are harvested from underwater Candle Kelp plants. Increase marine efficiency by upgrading the Exosuit Aeration Membrane, or refill oxygen supplies in suit by consuming Kelp Sacs from the vine.
hint.PLANT_POOP: Faecium is a nitrogen-rich organic material harvested from the dung of many large animals. Feed animals to increase faecium production. It is possible to grow faecium given the right environment and correct host plant. Seek advice from an Agricultural Specialist.
hint.SPACEGUNK2: Locate Runaway Mould in neglected corners of the universe, or germinate a new colony by processing Pugneum and Atlantideum with a Medium or Large Refiner.
hint.SPACEGUNK4: Locate Living Slime in neglected corners of the universe, or attempt creation of your own pulsating goo by processing Atlantideum and Mordite with a Medium or Large Refiner.
hint.AF_METAL: Tainted Metal is an unusually soft and porous metal, found in the wrecks of derelict freighters. Locate derelicts with the use of an Emergency Signal Scanner, purchaseable from a Space Station Scrap Dealer.
hint.SUNGOLD: Liquid Sun is superheated, stabilised planetary metal. Transmuted from metallic terrain deposits using a Solar Ray.
hint.SOULFRAG: Fragmented Qualia are bits of data, each representing a recording of the electrical impulses running across a neural network. Many fragments would be required to recreate any sensible experience. Generated by the interaction of the Animus Beam with a living target.
hint.SQUIDFRAG: Shattered Qualia are bits of data etched into ethereal shards of glass, the echoes of waveforms from long-evaporated neural networks. Released upon the destruction of a boundary horror.
hint.WORMDUST: Cursed Dust gathers in the terrain deposits of planets blighted by titan worm activity.
hint.TIMEDUST: Somnal Dust, the accumulated decay of time and memories, is found in the wrecks of derelict freighters caught within the loop. Locate derelicts with the use of an Emergency Signal Scanner, purchaseable from a Space Station Scrap Dealer.
hint.TIMEMILK: Ancestral Memories are echoes of genetic possibilities, forgotten by evolution. Harvest Ancestral Memories from friendly creatures caught within the loop. Befriend creatures by feeding them Creature Pellets.
hint.SWARMDUST: A syrupy metal with a cloying, coppery smell. Corrupted ichor is extracted from the shattered bodies of swarmers. Engage swarms in space combat to release corrupted ichor from their shells.
hint.ASTBELT1: Harvest from comet fragments in deep-space asteroid belts, using a Mining Beam. In the Star System Map (SOLARSYS_TOGGLEMAP), mark deep-space signals to travel to them. Use the Quick Menu (QUICK_MENU) to eject from the starship and commence extravehicular activity. While spacewalking in an asteroid belt, locate comet fragments with the Analysis Visor (AIM).
hint.HULK1: Harvest from the wreckage of interstellar hulks in deep space, using a Mining Beam. In the Star System Map (SOLARSYS_TOGGLEMAP), mark deep-space signal to travel to them. Use the Quick Menu (QUICK_MENU) to eject from the starship and commence extravehicular activity. While spacewalking, locate items with the Analysis Visor.
hint.SLIMEPOST1: Harvest from biohazard sites in deep space, using a Mining Beam. In the Star System Map (SOLARSYS_TOGGLEMAP), mark deep-space signal to travel to them. Use the Quick Menu (QUICK_MENU) to eject from the starship and commence extravehicular activity. While spacewalking, locate items with the Analysis Visor.
hint.CASING: Craft Metal Plating from Ferrite Dust. Use PRODMENU to craft in empty Inventory Slots. Harvest Ferrite Dust from small rocks using the Mining Laser. Fire the laser with ATTACK.
hint.NANOTUBES: Craft Carbon Nanotubes from Carbon. Use PRODMENU to craft in empty Inventory Slots. Gather Carbon from plants and trees using the Mining Laser. Fire the laser with ATTACK.
hint.CARBON_SEAL: Craft Hermetic Seals from Condensed Carbon. Use PRODMENU to craft in empty Inventory Slots. Refine Condensed Carbon from Carbon. Condensed Carbon can occasionally be found as crystals on planet surfaces.
hint.MICROCHIP: Craft %ITEM%, or purchase at a Trade Terminal. Find Trade Terminals on planetary outposts or onboard the Space Station.
hint.HYDRALIC: Craft %ITEM% from Carbon Nanotubes, Salt and Chromatic Metal. Craft Carbon Nanotubes from Carbon. Use PRODMENU to craft in empty Inventory Slots. Salt is readily extracted from underwater rock deposits. Increase marine efficiency by upgrading the Exosuit Aeration Membrane or by refilling oxygen supplies from Kelp Sacs. Chromatic Metal is created in a Refiner from the stellar metals: Copper, Cadmium, Emeril and Indium.
hint.COMPUTER: Craft %ITEM% from Microprocessors, Antimatter and Chromatic Metal. Craft Microprocessors or purchase at a Trade Terminal. Craft Antimatter from Chromatic Metal and Condensed Carbon. Chromatic Metal is created in a Refiner from the stellar metals: Copper, Cadmium, Emeril and Indium.
hint.MAGNET: Craft %ITEM% from Magnetised Ferrite and Ionised Cobalt. Use a Refiner to process advanced materials. Cobalt is found underground. Locate natural cave entrances. WARNING: many caves contain hazardous flora. Gather Ferrite from planetary rocks.
hint.MIRROR: Craft %ITEM% from Gold, Silver and Chromatic Metal. Gold and Silver are valuable interstellar trading minerals, most commonly mined from asteroids. They are occasionally found in underground planetary deposits. Chromatic Metal is created in a Refiner from the stellar metals: Copper, Cadmium, Emeril and Indium.
hint.BIO: Craft %ITEM% from Metal Plating, Condensed Carbon and Chlorine. Craft Metal Plating from Ferrite or purchase at a Trade Terminal. Refine Condensed Carbon from Carbon. Condensed Carbon can occasionally be found as crystals on planet surfaces. Refine Chlorine from Salt, which is harvested from underwater mineral deposits.
hint.TECH_COMP: Purchase %ITEM% from the Trade Terminal found aboard Space Stations or in planetary shops.
hint.PRODFUEL2: Craft %ITEM% from Di-hydrogen Jelly and Carbon. Use PRODMENU to craft in empty Inventory Slots. Refine or craft Di-hydrogen Jelly from the blue Di-hydrogen Crystals found on all worlds. Use the Scanner (SCAN) to locate crystals.
hint.POWERCELL: Craft %ITEM% from Cobalt and Ferrite dust. Use PRODMENU to craft in empty Inventory Slots. Cobalt is found underground. Locate natural cave entrances. WARNING: many caves contain hazardous flora. Supplies are occasionally found in Supply Caches left on planets.
hint.SHIPCHARGE: Craft %ITEM% from Gold and Tritium. Use PRODMENU to craft in empty Inventory Slots. Gold and Tritium are most commonly mined from asteroids.
hint.JELLY: Refine or craft Di-hydrogen Jelly from the blue Di-hydrogen Crystals found on all worlds. Use the Scanner (SCAN) to locate crystals.
hint.LAUNCHFUEL: Craft %ITEM% from Di-hydrogen and Metal Plating Di-hydrogen is found in crystal form on most planets. Locate di-hydrogen crystals with the Scanner (SCAN). Metal Plating is crafted from Ferrite Dust. Use PRODMENU to craft in empty Inventory Slots.
hint.SUBFUEL: Craft %ITEM% from cyto-phosphate, salt and carbon. All these elements are readily extracted from underwater plants.
hint.GRENFUEL1: Purchase %ITEM% from Trade Terminals and Shops. Craft %ITEM% from Oxygen and Metal Plating. Use PRODMENU to craft in empty Inventory Slots. Supplies are occasionally found in Supply Caches left on planets.
hint.AM_HOUSING: Craft %ITEM% from Oxygen and Ferrite Dust. Use PRODMENU to craft in empty Inventory Slots. Supplies are occasionally found in Supply Caches left on planets.
hint.ANTIMATTER: Craft %ITEM% from Condensed Carbon and Chromatic Metal. Use PRODMENU to craft in empty Inventory Slots. Refine Condensed Carbon from regular, plant-based carbon. Refine Chromatic Metal from large mineral deposits found with the Analysis Visor.
hint.HYPERFUEL1: Craft %ITEM% from Antimatter and Antimatter Housing. Use PRODMENU to craft in empty Inventory Slots.
hint.QUAD_PROD: Harvest Quad Servos from the remains of Sentinel Quads, an advanced combat unit deployed at high alert levels. Collect loot from defeated Sentinels by destroying Combat Supply Barrels.
hint.SPIDER_PROD: Harvest Crystallised Hearts from the remains of Corrupted Sentinel Quads. These advanced units are only found on dissonant worlds. Collect loot from defeated Sentinels by destroying Combat Supply Barrels.
hint.MECH_PROD: Harvest Hardsuit Engines from the remains of Sentinel Hardframe Units, a combat exo-mech deployed at high alert levels. Collect items from defeated Sentinels by destroying Combat Supply Barrels.
hint.SHIPBRAIN: Harvest Hyaline Brains from the remains of Sentinel Interceptor Ships, lethal starcraft deployed to maintain law and order in regulated space. Increase your Wanted Level in space to engage System Authorities
hint.DRONE_SALVAGE: Harvest Inverted Mirrors from the corrupted swarm's Dissonance Resonators. These foul machines can be found with the Analysis Visor (AIM) on worlds with a corrupted Sentinel presence.
hint.DRONE_SHARD: Harvest Radiant Shards from the crystals that sprout from the soil of corrupted Sentinel planets. These strange crystalline growths can be found with the Analysis Visor (AIM) on worlds with a corrupted Sentinel presence.
hint.SACVENOM: Collect %ITEM% from rare Land Urchins found occasionally on planets. Harvesting may require a Haz-Mat Gauntlet. Recruit a Base Armourer to learn the blueprint. WARNING: Land Urchins have spine-based defenses.
hint.GRAVBALL: Collect %ITEM% from rare Gravitino Hosts found occasionally on planets. WARNING: Gravitino Hosts are monitored by Sentinel forces.
hint.ALBUMENPEARL: Collect %ITEM% from rare Sentient Plants found occasionally on lush planets. WARNING: Sentient Plants are monitored by Sentinel forces.
hint.CAVECUBE: Collect %ITEM% from ancient artifacts found occasionally in caves. Locate natural cave entrances or create your own with the Terrain Manipulator. WARNING: many caves contain hazardous flora.
hint.FIENDCORE: Larval Cores are the pungent, gooey hearts of Whispering Eggs, often found laid on airless planets, or around abandoned buildings. CAUTION: Monstrous broods will guard their larvae fiercely. Locate Whispering Eggs using the Analysis Visor.
hint.STORM_CRYSTAL: Storm Crystals occur naturally on planets with extreme weather, and can be harvested during an active storm. Locate Storm Crystals using the Analysis Visor.
hint.CLAMPEARL: Living Pearls are harvested from Armoured Clams found on the sea bed. Use the Galaxy Map to locate systems with aquatic life. While swimming, identify Armoured Clams with the Analysis Visor. Increase marine efficiency by upgrading the Exosuit Aeration Membrane, refilling oxygen supplies from Kelp Sacs, or travelling in a Nautilon Submarine.
hint.VENTGEM: Crystal Sulphide gems are found around hydrothermal vents on the sea bed. Use the Galaxy Map to locate systems with ocean planets. While swimming, look for glowing or bubbling hydrothermal vents on the sea bed. Increase marine efficiency by upgrading the Exosuit Aeration Membrane, refilling oxygen supplies from Kelp Sacs, or travelling in a Nautilon Submarine.
hint.FISHCORE: Hadal Cores are found around alluring plant specimens on the sea bed. Use the Galaxy Map to locate systems with ocean planets. CAUTION: Hadal cores attract biological anomalies. While swimming, identify Alluring Specimens with the Analysis Visor. Increase marine efficiency by upgrading the Exosuit Aeration Membrane, refilling oxygen supplies from Kelp Sacs, or travelling in a Nautilon Submarine.
hint.ALLOY1: Craft or refine %ITEM% from Paraffinium and Ionised Cobalt. Refining advanced products requires a Large Refiner. Paraffinium is found in large deposits on lush planets with an Analysis Visor. Refine Chlorine from Salt, which is harvested from underwater mineral deposits.
hint.ALLOY2: Craft or refine %ITEM% from Pyrite and Pure Ferrite. Refining advanced products requires a Large Refiner. Pyrite is found in large deposits on barren planets with an Analysis Visor. Refine Pure Ferrite from ferrite dust, found in common minerals.
hint.ALLOY3: Craft or refine %ITEM% from Ammonia and Chlorine. Refining advanced products requires a Large Refiner. Ammonia is found in large deposits on toxic planets with an Analysis Visor. Refine Chlorine from Salt, which is harvested from underwater mineral deposits.
hint.ALLOY4: Craft or refine %ITEM% from Uranium and Pure Ferrite. Refining advanced products requires a Large Refiner. Uranium is found in large deposits on radioactive planets with an Analysis Visor. Refine Pure Ferrite from ferrite dust, found in common minerals.
hint.ALLOY5: Craft or refine %ITEM% from Phosphorus and Ionised Cobalt. Refining advanced products requires a Large Refiner. Phosphorus is found in large deposits on scorched planets with an Analysis Visor. Refine Ionised Cobalt from Cobalt, which is harvested from subterranean mineral deposits.
hint.ALLOY6: Craft or refine %ITEM% from Dioxite and Ionised Cobalt. Refining advanced products requires a Large Refiner. Dioxite is found in large deposits on frozen planets with an Analysis Visor. Refine Ionised Cobalt from Cobalt, which is harvested from subterranean mineral deposits.
hint.ALLOY7: Craft or refine %ITEM% from Herox, Dirty Bronze and Lemmium. Refining advanced products requires a Large Refiner.
hint.ALLOY8: Craft or refine %ITEM% from Aronium, Magno-Gold and Grantine. Refining advanced products requires a Large Refiner.
hint.NIPNIPBUDS: NipNip Buds are available for purchase in outlaw systems, or can be harvested from the NipNip plant. The host plant can be farmed in all environments with the aid of a Hydroponics Tray.
hint.EXP_CURIO1: The metallic shell of a disconnected electronic lifeform that was too distant from its kind to be refreshed with a new entity. Pilots at Trade Outposts on Korvax worlds may offer Korvax Casings for trade.
hint.FARMPROD1: Craft from Mordite and Fungal Mould. Learn the blueprint with the aid of a Science Specialist in a base. Fungal Mould can be farmed, or found wild on toxic planets. Mordite is harvested from the corpses of creatures
hint.FARMPROD2: Craft from Faecium and Gamma Root. Learn the blueprint with the aid of a Science Specialist in a base. Gamma Root can be farmed, or found wild on radioactive planets. Faecium is harvested from the excrement of wild animals. Feed wild animals to increase production.
hint.FARMPROD3: Refine from Silicate Powder. Extract silicate from the earth with a Terrain Manipulator. Craft with Frost Crystals harvested from frozen worlds. Learn the blueprint with the aid of a Construction Overseer.
hint.FARMPROD4: Craft from Frost Crystals and Solanium. Learn the blueprint with the aid of a Science Specialist in a base. Frost Crystals can be farmed, or found wild on frozen planets. Solanium can be farmed, or found wild on scorched planets.
hint.FARMPROD5: Craft from Cactus Flesh and Star Bulbs. Learn the blueprint with the aid of a Science Specialist in a base. Cactus Flesh can be farmed, or found wild on barren planets. Star Bulbs can be farmed, or found wild on lush planets.
hint.FARMPROD6: Craft from Cactus Flesh. Learn the blueprint with the aid of a Science Specialist in a base. Cactus Flesh can be farmed, or found wild on barren planets.
hint.FARMPROD7: Craft from Acid and Unstable Gel. Learn the blueprint with the aid of a Science Specialist in a base.
hint.FARMPROD8: Craft from Lubricant and Glass. Learn the blueprint with the aid of a Science Specialist in a base.
hint.FARMPROD9: Craft from Heat Capacitors and Poly Fibre. Learn the blueprint with the aid of a Science Specialist in a base.
hint.REACTION1: Craft from Sulphurine and Condensed Carbon. Learn the blueprint by raiding planetary factories or from the Synthesis Lab on the Space Anomaly. Harvest Sulphurine with an Atmosphere Harvester on Scorched and Barrenworlds. Refine Condensed Carbon from regular, plant-based Carbon.
hint.REACTION2: Craft from Radon and Condensed Carbon. Learn the blueprint by raiding planetary factories or from the Synthesis Lab on the Space Anomaly. Harvest Radon with an Atmosphere Harvester on Radioactive and Frozen worlds. Refine Condensed Carbon from regular, plant-based Carbon.
hint.REACTION3: Craft from Nitrogen and Condensed Carbon. Learn the blueprint by raiding planetary factories or from the Synthesis Lab on the Space Anomaly. Harvest Nitrogen with an Atmosphere Harvester on Lush and Toxic worlds. Refine Condensed Carbon from regular, plant-based Carbon.
hint.COMPOUND1: Craft from gas-based products, Thermic Condensate and Enriched Carbon. Learn the relevant blueprints by raiding planetary factories or from the Synthesis Lab on the Space Anomaly.
hint.COMPOUND2: Craft from gas-based products, Thermic Condensate and Nitrogen Salt. Learn the relevant blueprints by raiding planetary factories or from the Synthesis Lab on the Space Anomaly.
hint.COMPOUND3: Craft from gas-based products, Enriched Carbon and Nitrogen Salt. Learn the relevant blueprints by raiding planetary factories or from the Synthesis Lab on the Space Anomaly.
hint.COMPOUND4: Craft from gas-based products: Organic Catalyst and Nitrogen Salt. Learn the relevant blueprints by raiding planetary factories or from the Synthesis Lab on the Space Anomaly.
hint.COMPOUND5: Craft from gas-based products: Semiconductors and Enriched Carbon. Learn the relevant blueprints by raiding planetary factories or from the Synthesis Lab on the Space Anomaly.
hint.COMPOUND6: Craft from gas-based products: Hot Ice and Thermic Condensate. Learn the relevant blueprints by raiding planetary factories or from the Synthesis Lab on the Space Anomaly.
hint.MEGAPROD1: Highly advanced crafting product. Learn the relevant blueprints by raiding planetary factories or from the Synthesis Lab on the Space Anomaly. Craft from Liquid Explosive and Fusion Accelerant.
hint.MEGAPROD2: Highly advanced crafting product. Learn the relevant blueprints by raiding planetary factories or from the Synthesis Lab on the Space Anomaly. Craft from Circuit Boards and Superconductors.
hint.MEGAPROD3: Highly advanced crafting product. Learn the relevant blueprints by raiding planetary factories or from the Synthesis Lab on the Space Anomaly. Craft from Living Glass and Cryo-Pumps.
hint.ULTRAPROD1: Highly advanced crafting product. Learn the relevant blueprints by raiding planetary factories or from the Synthesis Lab on the Space Anomaly. Craft from Portable Reactor, Quantum Processor and Geodesite
hint.ULTRAPROD2: Highly advanced crafting product. Learn the relevant blueprints by raiding planetary factories or from the Synthesis Lab on the Space Anomaly. Craft from Quantum Processor, Cryogenic Chamber and Iridesite
hint.FUELPROD3: Craft or refine %ITEM% from Condensed Carbon. Refining advanced products requires a Large Refiner. Supplies of %ITEM% are very occasionally found inside rare planetary crystals.
hint.LANDPROD3: Craft or refine %ITEM% from Pure Ferrite. Refining advanced products requires a Large Refiner. Supplies of %ITEM% are very occasionally found inside rare planetary crystals.
hint.CAVEPROD3: Craft or refine %ITEM% from Ionised Cobalt. Refining advanced products requires a Large Refiner. Supplies of %ITEM% are very occasionally found inside rare planetary crystals.
hint.WATERPROD3: Craft or refine %ITEM% from Chlorine. Refining advanced products requires a Large Refiner. Supplies of %ITEM% are very occasionally found inside rare planetary crystals.
hint.CATAPROD3: Craft or refine %ITEM% from Sodium Nitrate. Refining advanced products requires a Large Refiner. Supplies of %ITEM% are very occasionally found inside rare planetary crystals.
hint.OXYPROD3: Craft or refine %ITEM% from Oxygen. Refining advanced products requires a Large Refiner. Supplies of %ITEM% are very occasionally found inside rare planetary crystals.
hint.OXY_CRAFT: Craft Oxygen Filters from Oxygen. Use PRODMENU to craft in empty Inventory Slots. Oxygen can be harvested from red plants found on all planets. Locate oxygen-rich plants with the Scanner (SCAN).
hint.WATER_CRAFT: Craft Salt Refractors from Salt. Use PRODMENU to craft in empty Inventory Slots. Salt is readily extracted from underwater rock deposits. Increase marine efficiency by upgrading the Exosuit Aeration Membrane or by refilling oxygen supplies from Kelp Sacs.
hint.CAVE_CRAFT: Craft Cobalt Mirrors from Cobalt. Use PRODMENU to craft in empty Inventory Slots. Cobalt is readily extracted from subterranean rock deposits. Locate natural cave entrances.
hint.CATA_CRAFT: Craft Sodium Diodes from Sodium. Use PRODMENU to craft in empty Inventory Slots. Sodium is harvested from yellow plants found on all planets. Locate sodium-rich plants with the Scanner (SCAN).
hint.PRODFUEL1: Craft %ITEM% from Oxygen and Ferrite dust. Use PRODMENU to craft in empty Inventory Slots. Supplies are occasionally found in Supply Caches left on planets.
hint.POWERCELL2: Craft %ITEM% from Ionised Cobalt and Pure Ferrite. Use a Refiner to process advanced materials. Cobalt is found underground. Locate natural cave entrances. WARNING: many caves contain hazardous flora. Supplies are occasionally found in Supply Caches left on planets.
